Duskhold Castle – license (FREE)

You may use these assets in free and commercial games and apps, modified or not. Credit appreciated, not required.
You may not resell or redistribute the assets themselves (alone or in another asset pack), or claim them as your own.

How it was made: surface painting of textures, props, icons and two parallax layers was AI-assisted (ChatGPT image
generation over our own grey-box layouts). The grid, 47-blob/16-mask autotile, cutting, anchors, animated FX,
code-drawn sky/moon/clouds/mist, JSON, Tiled/Godot files and the demo are our own work.
